details: For every finite binary class, $\mathrm E(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{VCR}^{p}(\mathcal H)$.
proof: Every coordinate projection has effective range contained in the original effective range. Its effective VC radius is at most the size of that projected effective range, so maximizing over projections still gives at most $\mathrm E(\mathcal H)$.
name: Effective Range / Projected VC Radius
